finding: While the rates of fractures and other birth trauma declined among infants delivered by spontaneous vaginal delivery, the rate of birth trauma remained unchanged in instrumental vaginal delivery and caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The rate of severe birth trauma declined in spontaneous vaginal delivery, the rates of fractures and other severe birth trauma declined, the rate of third/fourth degree lacerations declined in spontaneous vaginal delivery and in vacuum delivery, and declined among women with forceps delivery.
